wishlist.description: Tools that would help but are not installed.

shared.description: A role that only reads (review, research, watching logs): no folder of its own, works in the main folder with main's skills and plugins. Give it no dir, branch, skills or plugins.

dir.description: "." for main, "../<repo>-team/<role>" (or the older "../<repo>-<role>") for a sub role.

branch.description: Branch the sub role's worktree works on. Required for sub roles.

model.description: Model this role's window runs: an alias (opus, sonnet, haiku) or a model id. Written to its .claude/settings.local.json. Omit to use your default.

autonomy.description: ask: send main a plan and wait. build: change, test, commit on its own branch, then report. run: keep going through fix/test loops, report once at the end.
